run.name: Magnite Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (MGNI)
run.summary: Magnite is a low-leverage credit: gross debt is 1.27x last-twelve-months Adjusted EBITDA and cash exceeds debt, with a single term loan due in 2031. The business is cyclical and concentrated in a few buyers. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is MAGNITE, INC..

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 357,730 (Q3Q p17); cash 392,862 (Q3Q p2); LTM Adjusted EBITDA 280,586 derived. Negative net leverage means cash exceeds debt. Debt excludes lease liabilities and uses principal, not carrying value.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 280,586 over LTM cash interest 25,549 (nine-month cash interest 19,064 and 21,674; Q3Q p6). Interest paid on the repaid convertible notes is small; the October 2026 repricing is not reflected.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 392,862 thousand (Q3Q p2) including $78.1 million in foreign-currency accounts (Q3Q p50); availability $170.9 million net of $4.1 million letters of credit (Q3Q p20). Revolver matures February 2029; cash is partly customer-related working capital.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit agreement, covenant definitions and ratings are not supplied, and part of the cash is customer float.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA adds back stock compensation; the credit agreement and covenant definitions are not supplied.
